guidance.summary: Targeting $2 billion in revenue by end of FY27
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
guidance.quote: We are making steady progress towards our aspiration of reaching $2 billion by end of FY27.

guidance.summary: Targeting $5 billion revenue over next 4 to 5 years
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
guidance.quote: And as we get to our $5 billion over the next 4-5 years, we should be at, you know, $100 million per quarter in every sub -vertical.

guidance.summary: Expecting 100 basis points EBIT margin improvement in FY26
guidance.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
guidance.quote: But on an overall note, if we are looking at our current trajectory, we are looking at 100 basis point improvement in FY26 , and probably another 100 basis point in FY27.

guidance.summary: Effective tax rate for FY26 expected between 22.5% and 23.5%
guidance.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
guidance.quote: As discussed in the previous quarter's earnings call, the effective tax rate for FY26 is likely to remain in the range of 22.5% to 23.5%.
